prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in Fort Lauderdale FL for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company for every rental home, but **Metro Residential LLC** looks like a strong local option to start with. It focuses on residential properties in the Fort Lauderdale area—including homes—and reports more than 25 years of experience. A third-party listing shows a 4.5-star Google rating from 55 reviews. [Metro Residential](https://www.metrofla.com/) · [review listing](https://propertymanagement.com/property-manager/metro-residential-llc-fort-lauderdale-fl)

I’d also compare **Real Property Management Coral**, which says it handles single homes as well as larger portfolios, and **TEND Property Management**, which specifically manages single-family homes. [RPM Coral](https://www.rpmcoral.com/) · [TEND](https://www.tendpropertymanagement.com/)

Before choosing, ask each for a written, all-in fee schedule and sample management agreement. Compare leasing and renewal fees, maintenance markups, inspection frequency, cancellation terms, and how quickly they respond to owners. The best fit will depend on your home’s location, whether it’s occupied, and how hands-on you want to be.
